618-3817-4247.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-3129-4094-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7934.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2073-5256-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4399-4770-5870-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat.
4399-4770-5870-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
1849-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

789-1580-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-4142-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6146.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Ravenloft Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

104-2034-2557-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2034-2557-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1409-1770-5423.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve both Swashbuckler Extraordinaire triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2440-2967-4613.description:
Activate Pashalik Mons by paying {4} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons ability from step 1, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice, adding {C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Repeat.

967-2511-2557-3809-7087.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

585-1399-1606-1671.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

3817-4681-6798.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

955-2457-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4050-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding one mana of any color.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1580-4050-6462.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat

165-1069-5223-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-5223-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3719-5326-5361.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3719-5326-5361.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Auton Soldier and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Auton Soldier to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Auton Soldier by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2510-2866-4970-5751--49.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil
2510-2866-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1274-2060-4222-5027.notablePrerequisites:
Gnostro does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Gnostro.
You have a storm count of at least one.
1274-2060-4222-5027.description:
Activate Gnostro by tapping it, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Gnostro.
Repeat.

3018-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Rancor, adding {2}.
Rancor triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Rancor by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat.

2281-3405-4549-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
2281-3405-4549-5170.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Junji and Saffi, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Junji.
Activate Ayli's first ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Junji.
Junji dies, triggering itself and Saffi.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Ayli ability from step 3, causing you to gain five life.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life and infinite colored mana, you may instead sacrifice Junji to Ayli's second ability to exile all nonland permanents your opponents control.

2816-4188.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Accomplished Alchemist.
2816-4188.notablePrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist does not have summoning sickness. You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
2816-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3490-4659-4968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
3490-4659-4968.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact you control, adding {C}{C}.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar, you may use them to activate its ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

643-1303-1409-2743.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Biovisionary.
643-1303-1409-2743.description:
Activate Biovisionary by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Biovisionary enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator and Necroduality.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing itself and Biovisionary.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Repeat steps 1-4 two additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

2573-4011-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three Islands between your hand, battlefield, and graveyard.
2573-4011-4377.description:
Play Islands from your graveyard until you control at least three Islands.
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

116-4222-5116.notablePrerequisites:
Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Kiora's Follower.
116-4222-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

856-1201-1651-4871.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Witch's Oven ability, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasure and Food, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Caludron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
